# Tekos Tasks

Three OKF Markdown bundles (ADR-0038), each linked from `../agent.okf.md`'s
`zuno.tasks`: `answer-technical-question.md` (the only one with a live
Agent Runtime route in v0, `POST /v1/agents/tekos/chat`), `find-relevant-docs.md`
and `check-my-drive-docs.md` (declared for the OKF catalog, v1 route work).
